# provider::docker::parse_image_ref

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: function. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Splits an image reference into `registry`, `repository`, `tag` and `digest`, normalized like the docker CLI. No registry means `docker.io`, a one-segment Docker Hub name gains `library/` (`nginx` is `docker.io` / `library/nginx`), and a reference with neither tag nor digest gets tag `latest`. Absent parts are empty strings. Invalid references are an error.

## Usage

```terraform
provider::docker::parse_image_ref(ref string) object({digest=string, registry=string, repository=string, tag=string})
```

## Parameters

| Position | Name | Type | Null allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `ref` | `string` |  | Image reference, e.g. `nginx`, `ghcr.io/org/app:1.2` or `app@sha256:...`. |

Returns `object({digest=string, registry=string, repository=string, tag=string})`. Provider functions need Terraform >= 1.8.

## Example

```terraform
locals {
  ref = provider::docker::parse_image_ref("ghcr.io/org/app:1.4.2")
  # ref = {
  #   registry   = "ghcr.io"
  #   repository = "org/app"
  #   tag        = "1.4.2"
  #   digest     = ""
  # }

  hub = provider::docker::parse_image_ref("nginx")
  # hub.registry = "docker.io", hub.repository = "library/nginx", hub.tag = "latest"
}

output "app_tag" {
  value = local.ref.tag
}
```
